title: The level encoder's embedding and the transitional vertebrae
analysis_tools: SchwingNet/tools/figure2_transitional.py (fused L5 and T13, pre-specified before it was run)
grid_tool: tools/fig2_heldout_embed.py via slurm/fig2_heldout.sh (job 40426323, GPU; outputs /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/or_ready/figure2/, pulled to SchwingNet/results/figure2/)
held_out_rule: NOT HELD OUT under eval_gate rule (selection split: best of 40 epochs kept on it); weights never trained on it

keys.rule: An evaluation item is HELD OUT for a checkpoint only if its patient key (tools/patient_keys.key_any; a render inherits its source CT subject) is in neither the train nor the val/selection set of that checkpoint nor of any ancestor in its initialisation chain. Public ImageNet/COCO pretraining is the only exempt ancestor, and only when declared. A non-empty `unresolved` makes touched_keys a lower bound.

cleaning.rule: drop a validation crop whose resolved person key is in the encoder's train keys

never_seen: the three C-ArmLSpine patients whose CBCT one labeller (SPINEPS/VERIDAH) reads with a sixth lumbar vertebra; CBCT renders under six device cards, in neither the train nor the val keys of the encoder. CONTESTED TRUTH: the second labeller (TotalSegmentator) reads the same five mobile bones as L1-L5 (Dice 0.928-0.954 against VERIDAH's L2-L6), VERIDAH's view holds no L1, and no lumbar level is agreed (results/spineps_ids/VERIFY.md, item 1a). Under that reading the starred crops are L5 and the ringed 'L3-L5' are L2-L4; the measurements in (c) are unchanged, only their names differ. Pre-specified primary cut: whole-vertebra box, AP and lateral views. The secondary cut (vertebral-body box) does NOT reproduce the L6 result: two-cluster silhouette of their L6 -0.067, called L6 0.07 (figure2_metrics.json heldout_l6.cells.body/primary.L6)
fused_L5: four validation persons (VerSe, Castellvi IIIb or IV) whose fused L5 is unlabelled in the release mask, so the body is never a target; drawn is their LAST FREE vertebra (L4), which a count up from the sacrum would call L5. Statistic: two-cluster cosine silhouette against the validation L4 and L5 clusters (both without these persons), > 0 nearer L4 (its name); the within-person control is their L3 against L3 and L4. Person means, no interval (four persons). Last free: -0.132 (n 1), 0.113 (n 4), -0.182 (n 1), 0.161 (n 1); ordinary L4 0.238, 6.6 % of ordinary L4 crops below zero. Control: 0.007 (n 1), 0.130 (n 5), -0.259 (n 1), 0.168 (n 1); ordinary L3 0.161. 2 of 4 persons' last free vertebra sits nearer L5 than L4 (< 0). The same persons' L3 against L3/L4: 0.007, -0.259, against the ordinary L3 mean 0.161 (5th percentile -0.048): read together, the pull toward the level below is not shown to be confined to the last free vertebra, and four persons cannot separate a junction effect from a person-level shift.
c_stars_vs_dots: the stars and diamonds are a two-cluster silhouette (a crop against the validation clusters of the two levels of its row, its own person out of both); computed the same way for the ordinary validation crops it gives L6|L5 0.338, L5|L4 0.227, L4|L3 0.170, L3|L2 0.159, L4|L5 0.238 and L3|L4 0.161, against the ordinary silhouettes drawn as dots
t13: no held-out T13 embedded. The bank: verified T13 spines by side of the encoder's keys {'train': 7} (transitional_subtypes.csv), T13 crops {'train': 44, 'val': 0}. Held-out T13 renders DO now exist, but every T13 the encoder never saw is a G3 test person in a blinded stratum (45 persons, by source ['cobra']: the automatic screen's calls, unread; census below), and LEVELCHECK_MODEL.md s9 makes the first run of any SchwingNet model on such a person the unblinding of the confirmatory analysis. So none was embedded, deliberately, and no GPU job was submitted. The one other candidate is not a T13 by the registry's rule (census below). The T12/T13/L1 neighbourhood has nothing held out to show; (b) is the lumbosacral window only. After unblinding, the sealed T13 and L6 test persons can be embedded with this encoder by tools/fig2_heldout_embed.py and drawn here

unseen_transitional_census.rule: a transitional person the v9 encoder never saw may be embedded only if it is not a G3 test person (LEVELCHECK_MODEL.md s9; strata.json gate 'blinded')
unseen_transitional_census.frozen_strata: results/fig6/frozen/v1/strata.json + split_final.json (sha256 ad50e00a7d1df2a5... of stratify.json at the freeze)
unseen_transitional_census.T13_candidates_in_other_streams_not_embe: none of these rows is a verified T13 (every one is a single-labeller call with the second labeller unresolved, no real frames) and none has a render: the rare-class render roots on the grid (/rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/rare_class, checked 2026-09-24 from the login node) are carmlspine_cbct_drr, ctsp_drr, totalsegmentator_drr and verse_drr only, and data/ribfrac holds CT images and members.json, no DRR. A verified T13 person outside both key sets with a render is the condition (tools/figure2_transitional.py); nothing meets it, so no GPU job was submitted
unseen_transitional_census.T13_candidate_outside_keys_not_embedded_: the one registry T13 candidate outside the v9 keys and outside the frozen strata (TotalSegmentator, G3 train side) is a single-labeller call: labeller B gave no count (15 rib-bearing bodies, a segmentation defect until a human says otherwise), its rib is one-sided, and the registry notes that VerSe's 38 mm rule names the body an L1 with a rudimentary rib. It has no rare-class render (grid check 2026-09-24 08:20: none of rare_class/{carmlspine_cbct_drr,ctsp_drr,totalsegmentator_drr,verse_drr} holds it, those roots last written 2026-09-23 18:25, and it is not in fig6/bank_g3_v2); one render exists in the TotalSegmentator v3 bench (~/ts_drr_v3), whose boxes carry TotalSegmentator names, so drawing a T13 would first need a single-labeller renaming. Not embedded; not a T13 by the registry's own rule
